notes: 1.0.0: the network test image: iperf3, client and server, for measuring a link's capacity between two hosts with no internet involved (first used to show a site's wired cross-connect ran at about a gigabit while its internet line ran at a few Mbit/s). iperf3 brings gcc-libs and glibc through its own runtime requirements, so they are not restated. Rolling, like every image.
